chunks: Then We saved him and those on his side by Our grace, and destroyed to the very last those who rejected Our signs and denied the truth.
ai.seo_question: How did God save the believers and destroy the disbelievers in this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse highlights the dual outcome of divine intervention: the salvation of the faithful through God's mercy and the complete eradication of the disbelievers who rejected the signs. Shia exegesis often emphasizes that 'those with him' includes not just the immediate followers but also the broader community of believers who maintained steadfastness, while 'cutting off the last generation' signifies the total removal of their influence and memory from history.
